stories.headline: Nvidia unveils Vera Rubin GPU at GTC 2026, projects $1 trillion AI chip revenue through 2027

key_facts.fact: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang unveiled the Vera Rubin GPU architecture at GTC 2026, delivering 5x inference performance improvement over Blackwell Ultra in FP4 workloads and a 10x reduction in inference token costs.
key_facts.excerpt: 5x inference performance improvement over Blackwell Ultra in FP4 workloads... 10x reduction in inference token costs

key_facts.fact: Nvidia said the revenue opportunity for its AI chips may reach at least $1 trillion through 2027, up from a previous forecast of $500 billion through 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: New revenue opportunity forecast marks big step-up from $500 billion seen through 2026

key_facts.fact: The VR200 NVL144 rack contains 144 Vera Rubin GPUs paired with the new Vera CPU and uses HBM4 memory with over 3.0 TB/s bandwidth.
key_facts.excerpt: VR200 NVL144 rack: 144 Vera Rubin GPUs + new Vera CPU... HBM4 memory with 3.0 TB/s+ bandwidth

key_facts.fact: Nvidia also unveiled the Groq 3 language processing unit for inference and a Vera CPU rack with 256 Vera CPUs featuring 88 custom Olympus cores each, aimed at competing with Intel and AMD.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia launches Groq 3 AI chip and CPU server aimed at Intel during GTC 2026... debuting a number of chips and platforms ranging from its all-new Nvidia Groq 3 language processing unit (LPU) to its massive Vera central processing unit (CPU) rack

key_facts.fact: Nvidia announced a multiyear strategic partnership with Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab to deploy at least one gigawatt of Vera Rubin systems for frontier model training.
key_facts.excerpt: multiyear strategic partnership to deploy at least one gigawatt of next-generation NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems to support Thinking Machines' frontier model training

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang declared: 'AI is no longer a single breakthrough or application — it is essential infrastructure. Every company will use it. Every nation will build it.'
key_facts.excerpt: AI is no longer a single breakthrough or application — it is essential infrastructure. Every company will use it. Every nation will build it.

stories.headline: Nvidia launches physical AI platform at GTC with Uber robotaxis in 28 cities and Disney robot demo

key_facts.fact: Nvidia and Uber announced an expanded partnership for Nvidia to provide the full autonomous driving software stack for Uber robotaxis launching in Los Angeles and San Francisco in H1 2027, scaling to 28 markets across four continents by end of 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia to power Uber robotaxis starting next year... 28 markets across four continents by end of 2028... initial rollout in Los Angeles and San Francisco

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang demonstrated a walking, talking Disney Olaf robot that learned to move via reinforcement learning in Nvidia's Omniverse simulator with 100,000 virtual copies training on an RTX 4090 in just two days; Olaf debuts at Disneyland Paris on March 29.
key_facts.excerpt: sticking 100,000 virtual copies of the physical Olaf robot into a Nvidia-powered simulation and rewarding him for screen-accurate moves. It took just two days to train Olaf with an Nvidia RTX 4090

key_facts.fact: Nvidia partnered with major robotics companies including ABB Robotics, FANUC, Figure, KUKA, Agility, Universal Robots, Skild AI, World Labs, and YASKAWA to deploy production-scale physical AI systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Industry leaders building on the NVIDIA platform include ABB Robotics, AGIBOT, Agility, FANUC, Figure, Hexagon Robotics, KUKA, Skild AI, Universal Robots, World Labs and YASKAWA

key_facts.fact: Nvidia unveiled new Cosmos 3 world foundation model, Isaac GR00T N1.7 (in early access), and previewed GR00T N2 which ranks #1 on MolmoSpaces and RoboArena benchmarks.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA also unveiled new NVIDIA Isaac simulation frameworks and new NVIDIA Cosmos and NVIDIA Isaac GR00T open models for the industry to develop, train and deploy the next generation of intelligent robots

key_facts.fact: Huang declared 'Physical AI has arrived — every industrial company will become a robotics company' as Nvidia positions physical AI and robotics as a trillion-dollar opportunity.
key_facts.excerpt: Physical AI has arrived — every industrial company will become a robotics company. NVIDIA's full-stack platform — spanning computing, open models and software frameworks — is the foundation

stories.headline: Nvidia announces Vera Rubin Space-1 Module for orbital data centers with 25x H100 performance

key_facts.fact: Nvidia unveiled the Vera Rubin Space-1 Module at GTC 2026, combining IGX Thor and Jetson Orin computing platforms, delivering up to 25x the AI compute performance of the H100 GPU for space-based inferencing.
key_facts.excerpt: the Vera Rubin Space Module, which can run AI models, but from orbit. The module contains a GPU using Nvidia's latest 'Rubin' architecture, and promises to deliver an up to a 25-times performance leap from the H100 GPU

key_facts.fact: Partners include Axiom Space, Starcloud, and Planet Labs, with the chips engineered for size-, weight-, and power-constrained environments on satellites and space stations.
key_facts.excerpt: Partners include Axiom Space, Starcloud and Planet... chips are specifically 'engineered for size-, weight- and power-constrained environments'

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang said 'Space computing, the final frontier, has arrived. As we deploy satellite constellations and explore deeper into space, intelligence must live wherever data is generated.'
key_facts.excerpt: Space computing, the final frontier, has arrived. As we deploy satellite constellations and explore deeper into space, intelligence must live wherever data is generated.

key_facts.fact: Huang acknowledged cooling remains a key engineering challenge: 'In space, there's no convection, there's just radiation, and so we have to figure out how to cool these systems out in space.'
key_facts.excerpt: In space, there's no convection, there's just radiation, and so we have to figure out how to cool these systems out in space, but we've got lots of great engineers working on it.

stories.headline: Micron enters high-volume production of HBM4 memory for Nvidia Vera Rubin platform

key_facts.fact: Micron began high-volume shipment of HBM4 36GB 12-high stack in Q1 2026, designed for Nvidia Vera Rubin, achieving over 11 Gb/s pin speeds and greater than 2.8 TB/s bandwidth.
key_facts.excerpt: HBM4 with the 36 GB 12-high stack started shipping in volume in Q1 2026, built for NVIDIA Vera Rubin. It hits over 11 Gb/s pin speeds for more than 2.8 TB/s of bandwidth

key_facts.fact: The HBM4 delivers 2.3x the bandwidth and over 20% better power efficiency compared to its HBM3E predecessor; Micron has also shipped early samples of a 16-high 48GB variant.
key_facts.excerpt: 2.3 times what HBM3E offered, while also improving power efficiency by over 20%. Micron has also shipped early samples of a 16-high 48 GB variant

key_facts.fact: Micron also announced 192GB SOCAMM2 memory modules in high-volume production for Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPU platforms, enabling up to 2TB of memory and 1.2 TB/s bandwidth per CPU.
key_facts.excerpt: Micron SOCAMM2 is designed for NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems and standalone NVIDIA Vera CPU platforms, enabling up to 2TB of memory and 1.2 TB/s of bandwidth per CPU

key_facts.fact: The Micron 9650, the industry's first PCIe Gen 6 data center SSD, entered mass production for Nvidia BlueField-4 STX architecture, delivering 28 GB/s sequential read and 5.5 million random read IOPS.
key_facts.excerpt: Micron 9650, the industry first PCIe Gen 6 data center SSD... boasts sequential read speeds of up to 28 GB/s and can handle 5.5 million random read IOPS

stories.headline: Kepler Communications deploys first NVIDIA-powered cloud computing infrastructure in orbit

key_facts.fact: Kepler Communications announced the commissioning of distributed on-orbit computing across its Tranche 1 optical data relay constellation, the world's first commercially operational optical data relay network with compute capability.
key_facts.excerpt: Kepler Communications today announced the commissioning of distributed on-orbit computing across its Tranche 1 optical data relay constellation, the world's first commercially operational optical data relay network

key_facts.fact: The introductory on-orbit compute capability uses 40 NVIDIA Jetson Orin modules deployed as distributed edge compute GPUs across 10 satellites, interconnected through Kepler's real-time optical communications network.
key_facts.excerpt: Kepler's introductory on-orbit compute capability is powered by 40 NVIDIA Jetson Orin modules, deployed as distributed edge compute GPUs across 10 satellites and interconnected through Kepler's real-time optical communications network

key_facts.fact: The platform supports AI-driven Earth observation analytics, multi-sensor data fusion, RF signal intelligence, and autonomous network operations using NVIDIA CUDA-accelerated frameworks directly in space.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA-powered edge compute enables advanced applications such as AI-driven Earth observation analytics, multi-sensor data fusion, RF signal intelligence, autonomous network operations, and intelligent data optimization executed directly within the network

key_facts.fact: Kepler plans to scale the on-orbit compute offering with each additional satellite tranche launched, with each satellite functioning as a compute-enabled node accessible using terrestrial cloud tools.
key_facts.excerpt: The company plans to scale the on-orbit compute offering with each additional tranche launched. Each satellite functions as a compute-enabled node capable of supporting AI and other accelerated workloads

stories.headline: China launches Yaogan-50 02 remote sensing satellite on Long March-6A from Taiyuan

key_facts.fact: China launched the Yaogan-50 02 remote sensing satellite at 9:22 PM CST (13:22 UTC) on March 15, 2026, aboard a modified Long March-6A carrier rocket from the Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center in Shanxi Province.
key_facts.excerpt: The Yaogan-50 02 satellite was launched at 9:22 p.m. aboard a modified Long March-6 carrier rocket and has entered its planned orbit. The launch mission was a complete success.

key_facts.fact: The satellite was placed into a retrograde low Earth orbit, joining Yaogan-50 01 (launched in mid-January) to allow both satellites to pass over imaging targets at a more rapid pace than regular orbits.
key_facts.excerpt: Like the first satellite, the second one was also put into a retrograde low Earth orbit, allowing the two of them to pass over their imaging targets at a more rapid pace than a regular low Earth orbit

key_facts.fact: Yaogan-50 02 was developed by the China Academy of Space Technology (CAST), while Yaogan-50 01 was built by the Shanghai Academy of Spaceflight Technology, and innovation breakthroughs were achieved regarding communications bottlenecks.
key_facts.excerpt: developed by the China Academy of Space Technology... innovation breakthroughs were achieved with Yaogan-50-02's development, mainly regarding communications bottlenecks

key_facts.fact: The satellite is officially designated for land survey, crop yield estimation, and disaster prevention and relief. This marked the 633rd flight mission of the Long March carrier rocket series.
key_facts.excerpt: The satellite will be mainly used for land survey, crop yield estimation, and disaster prevention and relief. This launch marked the 633rd flight mission of the Long March carrier rocket series.

stories.headline: Parallel Flight's Firefly heavy-lift drone receives FAA Section 44807 exemption for commercial ops

key_facts.fact: The FAA granted Parallel Flight Technologies' Firefly heavy-lift drone a Section 44807 exemption, authorizing commercial operations in U.S. airspace for unmanned aircraft exceeding 55 pounds at takeoff.
key_facts.excerpt: The FAA has granted the Firefly heavy-lift drone a Section 44807 exemption, authorizing commercial operations in U.S. airspace

key_facts.fact: The Section 44807 exemption is the specific legal pathway for unmanned aircraft exceeding 55 pounds at takeoff, putting them outside the standard Part 107 small UAS rule, requiring rigorous safety architecture and platform maturity demonstrations.
key_facts.excerpt: The Section 44807 exemption is the specific legal pathway for unmanned aircraft that exceed 55 pounds at takeoff, putting them outside the standard Part 107 small UAS rule

key_facts.fact: The Firefly is a Group 3 quadcopter designed to be carried and transported by two people, representing a new class of commercially-approved heavy-lift drones for industrial use cases.
key_facts.excerpt: The Firefly is a Group 3 quadcopter that two people can carry, transport

stories.headline: India's Paninian unveils SVAYATT-M1 AI-powered loyal wingman drone for IAF fighter jets

key_facts.fact: Indian defense startup Paninian India unveiled the SVAYATT-M1 on March 15, an AI-enabled loyal wingman drone designed as a Collaborative Combat Aerial Vehicle (CCAV) to operate alongside Su-30MKI, Rafale, and upcoming AMCA fighter jets.
key_facts.excerpt: Paninian India Pvt Ltd has unveiled the SVAYATT-M1, an artificial intelligence-enabled loyal wingman drone developed as a Collaborative Combat Aerial Vehicle (CCAV) designed to operate alongside manned fighter aircraft during combat missions

key_facts.fact: The drone features a low-observable stealth airframe, indigenous turbofan engine, and the proprietary 'Kalman Intel' AI platform enabling GPS-denied navigation, terrain-following flight, real-time threat response, and multi-agent swarm coordination.
key_facts.excerpt: Low-observable stealth airframe... Indigenous turbofan engine... The 'Kalman Intel' proprietary AI platform enables GPS-denied navigation, terrain-following flight profiles, real-time threat response

key_facts.fact: Mission roles include ISR operations, electronic warfare, air-to-ground strikes, anti-ship missions, decoy operations, and cooperative swarm engagements, with production scaling targeted for 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: ISR operations, electronic warfare, air-to-ground strikes, anti-ship missions, decoy operations, and cooperative swarm engagements... Production scaling targeted for 2027

key_facts.fact: The Hyderabad-based startup was founded in 2020 by former DRDO and HAL engineers and targets over 85% localization in the supply chain with modular plug-and-play architecture for rapid payload integration.
key_facts.excerpt: founded in 2020 by former DRDO and HAL engineers... over 85% localization target in supply chain... Modular plug-and-play architecture for rapid payload integration

sources.title: Paninian India Reveals SVAYATT-M1 Autonomous Loyal Wingman Drone to Operate with IAF Fighter Jets
